title: Writing Task 1 - Bar Chart: Tourist Arrivals
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a bar chart showing international tourist arrivals in six countries.

stimuli.title: Task 1: International Tourist Arrivals — 2010 and 2022
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The bar chart below shows the number of international tourist arrivals (in millions) in six countries in 2010 and 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data (2010 / 2022 in millions): France: 77 / 90. Spain: 53 / 84. USA: 60 / 77. China: 56 / 65. Italy: 44 / 62. Turkey: 27 / 51.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the bar chart comparing international tourist arrivals in six countries in 2010 and 2022.

keyFeatures: France remained the top tourist destination in both years, though Spain closed the gap significantly
Turkey experienced the largest proportional growth, nearly doubling its arrivals
All six countries showed increases in tourist arrivals over the period
Italy and Turkey swapped relative positions, with Italy overtaking Turkey by 2022
